# Browser dependencies

Pinned, locally hosted UMD distributions, retrieved 2026-10-03:

- `fsrs.js`: `ts-fsrs` 5.4.2 from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/ts-fsrs@5.4.2/dist/index.umd.js. MIT license in `fsrs-LICENSE.txt`.
- `lucide.js`: `lucide` 1.51.0 from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lucide@1.51.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js. License and third-party notices in `lucide-LICENSE.txt`.

The scheduler avoids a home-grown spaced-repetition implementation. Lucide supplies the interface icons. No runtime CDN or package manager is needed to open the app.
